events.factual_description: Blue Note Jazz Club presents Robert Glasper feat. Derrick Hodge & Chris Dave from Wednesday, October 28 through Friday, October 30, 2026, with 8:00 PM and 10:30 PM sets each night. Blue Note's official event page confirms the exact billing, dates, showtimes and venue, and identifies Glasper's Robtober as entering its seventh year. Blue Note Records documents Derrick Hodge on bass and Chris Dave on drums as members of the Robert Glasper Experiment lineup behind Black Radio, alongside Glasper and Casey Benjamin. Blue Note's calendar also shows Hodge and Dave continuing with Glasper for separate Halloween and Robtober-finale billings on October 31 and November 1, making this a multi-night closing stretch rather than a one-off appearance.

en.why_it_matters: This is about the engine underneath a landmark cross-genre language. Glasper, Hodge and Dave were the piano-bass-drums core of the Experiment that made Black Radio feel less like jazz borrowing from hip-hop and R&B than a band speaking those vocabularies at once. Putting those three back at the center in a small club shifts attention to pocket, touch, harmonic elasticity and the split-second rhythmic decisions that made the project distinctive in the first place.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the six sets if New York is already in the corridor. The three-night run gives enough flexibility to choose the best evening, and the additional Halloween and finale appearances mean there is no need to reshape a larger Northeast trip around one specific set.

es.why_it_matters: Aquí importa el motor que estaba debajo de un lenguaje que de verdad cruzó fronteras. Glasper, Hodge y Dave fueron el núcleo piano-bajo-batería del Experiment que hizo que Black Radio no sonara a jazz tomando prestado del hip-hop y el R&B, sino a una banda hablando esos idiomas al mismo tiempo. Volver a poner a los tres en el centro de un club pequeño devuelve la atención al pocket, al tacto, a la elasticidad armónica y a esas decisiones rítmicas de una fracción de segundo que hicieron tan particular al proyecto.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los seis sets si Nueva York ya está dentro del corredor. Las tres noches dan margen para escoger la que mejor acomode, y las apariciones adicionales de Halloween y del cierre de residencia eliminan cualquier necesidad de reorganizar un viaje más grande por un set específico.
